title: Power of the product-space norm
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability distribution on $\Omega$, let $n$ be a natural number, let $p>0$, and let $f:(\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\Omega)\to\mathbb R$. The $p$th power of the product-space $L^p$ norm of $f$ equals the product-distribution mean of $|f|^p$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on length-$n$ sequences from $\Omega$
